description: This file contains type definitions and re-exports of functions and constants related to self-hosted provider setup helpers for OpenAI-compatible backends in a plugin SDK.

methods.name: applyProviderDefaultModel
methods.description: Sets the default model for the provider.

methods.name: configureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures a self-hosted provider in a non-interactive mode.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels
methods.description: Discovers local models compatible with OpenAI.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Discovers a self-hosted provider compatible with OpenAI.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Prompts user and configures a self-hosted provider.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderAuth
methods.description: Handles authentication prompting and configuration for self-hosted provider.
